Popular

Start here.

Start from a templateA gallery of ready-made starting points for every kind.
Split view: two or three documents side by sideRead one document while you write in another, like editor groups in VS Code.
The command barCtrl+Shift+P: type what you want to do instead of hunting for it.
Spelling, grammar and AutoCorrectRed dotted lines mark spelling, blue ones grammar; right-click for suggestions. Typos fix themselves as you type.
Make Doceo easier to read and useLarger text, higher contrast, a simpler screen, a readable font and bigger buttons.
Board, list, table and timelineEvery task has one card; look at your work the way that suits you.
Views, filters, sorting and groupingSave as many views as you like on one database.
SearchCtrl+K searches titles, labels, owners and the text of every page, plus tasks, whiteboards and app pages.
